text: The model reads a token and predicts the next token. A token is a unit of text. The scores are called logits. Softmax turns scores into probabilities. A likely token is not a verified fact. We check the source before using an answer.

Attention mixes value vectors from earlier positions. A query is compared with keys. The causal mask hides future positions. The head returns a weighted sum of values. Several heads learn several ways to combine information.

Training changes the weights. Inference uses the weights without updating them. A prompt gives temporary context. A database stores application memory. A cache saves intermediate keys and values while generating a continuation.

We split documents before building the vocabulary. The training set teaches patterns. The validation set helps us choose settings. The test set is reserved for final evaluation. Repeated sentences can make validation misleading.

The input and target differ by one position. The model sees hello and learns its continuation. Cross entropy rewards probability assigned to the observed next token. The optimizer uses gradients to change trainable parameters.
We save the weights, the vocabulary, and the configuration together. The service loads the model once at startup. The client sends a prompt. The server returns a continuation and measured latency.
